featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello, my name is Sharada Rakesh Kadam. My mother works in this hospital as a helper (maushi), and she always says that all the doctors here are very good. Based on her recommendation,Today I visited Paramount Hospital today to consult a dermatologist, Dr. Prateek Oswal.
When my turn came and I entered the cabin for my check-up, it seems that the receptionist had informed the doctor that I am the daughter of a staff member. On hearing this, the doctor became angry and said, “Whoever it is, I am not going to give any concession,” and abruptly hung up the phone. After that, the way my consultation was handled was extremely disappointing—something I could never have imagined. For a moment, I was even scared to ask him any questions.
I paid the full consultation fee as asked, and I had absolutely no issue paying it. However, the doctor should have at least clarified or spoken to me before reacting in such a manner.
I truly regret visiting based on my mother’s recommendation. I am a tax consultant by profession and have worked with reputed doctors in Mumbai. I have had direct professional interactions with well-known doctors from hospitals like SevenHills, Hinduja, and Surya Hospital, and I still have their direct contact numbers. Even today, if I have any concerns regarding my children or my husband, I can directly reach out to them. However, I have never had such a poor experience with any doctor before.
My mother continues to work there due to her financial condition, and she has no choice. I understand her situation. But after this experience, I will never visit this hospital again. This entire incident was extremely unprofessional and disappointing.

--------Thank you for responding to my review so quickly—I truly appreciate it.
I understand that my mother is an elderly woman, and she may sometimes ask for a discount. However, even if I had been charged ₹800 as a consultation fee, I would have paid it without any issue. My main concern was simply to get proper treatment for my skin infection. There was absolutely no need for such a reaction.
I would also like to mention that the hospitals I referred to earlier---------are places where I have known doctors personally since 2008. Till date, they have never charged me a consultation fee. So, this is not about the fee at all; it is about the way the situation was handled. The reaction was unnecessary and could have been avoided.
Honestly, I always pray to God that I have minimal need to visit doctors in life. During my consultation, when I asked Dr. Oswal whether I should use any normal anti-aging creams—as I am 40 years old and do not currently use anything on my skin—his response was quite unsatisfactory.

Anyway, I shared my experience as it happened. I sincerely hope that my mother receives respect at her workplace. Earlier, she worked at Dhanvantari Hospital, where everyone treated her very well. Yesterday’s experience, however, was quite different for me.

Thank you once again for your response. 🙏🙏🙏

For over 40 years, Dr. Sharat Menon Sir and Dr. Ruta Menon Madam have been the backbone of this 35+ bedded hospital, serving the Kurla community with unmatched dedication. With NICU and PICU facilities, this small setup manages an astounding 300 to 500 OPD patients daily, providing affordable, quality care to those who need it most.

It is often said in Kurla that this hospital has issued more yellow card files under Dr. Sharat Menon’s sir system than the total number of ration cards in the area, a powerful reflection of its far-reaching impact on countless families. Many pediatricians from across Maharashtra and other states have learned and trained here, now successfully practicing elsewhere—continuing the legacy of care started in this very hospital.

Despite criticism from some quarters about hygiene or staff, one must understand the ground reality: managing such a high patient volume 24/7, with limited space and a handful of staff, is an extraordinary challenge. Yet, the hospital has not only survived but flourished for over four decades, which speaks to the quality of care and the trust of the people.

Above all, Dr. Menon Sir is a man of service, not profit. Even today, at his age, he works tirelessly for his patients. Ask yourself—where in Mumbai will you find a pediatrician who, after 40 years of practice, charges only ₹100 for a follow-up consultation within a month? Even general practitioners charge far more. This alone shows his commitment to making healthcare accessible to all, not just the privileged.

No number of negative reviews can diminish the selfless service, quality care, and dedication this hospital has provided to the community for generations. This is not just a hospital; it is a lifeline for the people of Kurla—built on compassion, not commerce.

owner_posts.post_text: In a world that moves fast, yoga reminds us to slow down, breathe, and reconnect with ourselves.

A patient came to us after nearly three months of continuous fever following a knee replacement surgery. During this period, she had consulted multiple doctors across cities and was treated for common infections like typhoid, malaria and dengue. Despite repeated tests and treatments, the fever persisted, along with joint pain, mouth ulcers and extreme fatigue — without a clear diagnosis.

At SRV Hospitals, under the care of Dr. Avilash Tiwari @dr.avilash_tiwari, the approach shifted from treating symptoms to understanding the full cause. A structured evaluation for long-standing fever was initiated, looking beyond routine infections and considering inflammatory and immune-related conditions.

Advanced testing revealed two key findings. One was a mild, uncommon form of leptospirosis that does not present with the typical severe symptoms and often goes unnoticed. More importantly, investigations confirmed an autoimmune condition called Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), where the immune system becomes overactive and causes ongoing inflammation — leading to persistent fever and joint symptoms.

Update: I’ve experienced both private consultation and general OPD at Holy Spirit Hospital, and overall, it has been a bad experience.

The campus itself is beautiful and well maintained. Online appointment booking is smooth, while offline booking starts at 7:30 am and doctors typically begin consultations from around 8:30 am.

The private consultation experience (ENT, in my case) was genuinely good. The doctor gave adequate time, listened patiently, and the interaction felt reassuring and professional. However, this comes at a cost, as the visit including diagnostics ended up in the range of ₹3,000–4,000.

The general OPD experience was very bad. The charges are in the range of ₹400-700.

Earlier I had positive experiences with  Gastroenterology and Surgery. I was very much impressed with the surgeon, but his opinion was outrightly dismissed by 3 other senior surgeons and physicians. I realised he kept focussing on a know problem which wasn't connected to my pain.  Gastroenterologist doesn't do any physical examination to understand the location of pain or confirm hemorrhoids. Seems, he only checks you during pricey colonoscopy and endoscopy procedures.

My experience with General Medicine and Urology OPD was disappointing. In these departments, the main doctor and an assistant doctor sit at the same small table and consult two different patients simultaneously.

In General Medicine OPD, there were up to four patients along with their attendants inside the same room at once—one with the main doctor, one with the assistant, one waiting behind the doctor, and another at the entrance being triaged for blood pressure and weight. That easily translates to 8–10 people in a single consultation room. There is no space for discussion, questions, nuance, or privacy. The doctor barely had time for eye contact, let alone a detailed conversation or examination.

In the Urology OPD, I could speak to the actual doctor only after the assistant doctor felt I was not convinced. While I do not question the competence of junior doctors, as a patient it feels unfair when you do not get adequate time with the consultant you booked.

I guess this is the truth of INR 400-700 consultations. I sincerely hope the PRO and hospital administration take note of these inconsistencies, especially given Holy Spirit’s reputation as an esteemed institution.

I had a very positive experience at Holy Spirit Hospital. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcomed, respected, and well cared for. The doctors were highly knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which really put me at ease. It was an emergency and all was taken care of meticulously.

The nursing staff deserves special appreciation for their kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism. They were always quick to respond and ensured that I was comfortable throughout my stay. The hospital facilities were clean, well-maintained, and organized, reflecting a high standard of care.

Overall, I am grateful for the exceptional service and compassionate care I received. I would highly recommend Holy Spirit Hospital to anyone looking for reliable and quality healthcare.

featured_reviews.name: Atul Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I truly don’t have enough words to describe Holy Spirit Hospital. For our family, this hospital has truly been a God’s gift. My father was recently admitted to the emergency ward due to a heart attack.

The treatment and care were excellent throughout — from the emergency ward to the heart centre and the general ward. Everything was handled with great professionalism and compassion.

A special thanks to Dr. Amit Sharma, cardiologist, who is honestly one of the best doctors. He managed both humanity and professionalism so beautifully. His care, support, and dedication meant a lot to us during this difficult time.

A heartfelt thank you for my father’s treatment. God bless the entire team.

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Holy Spirit Hospital and was very impressed with the overall experience. The staff is polite, helpful, and highly professional. The doctors are experienced and make you feel comfortable by explaining the treatment in detail. The facilities are clean and well-organized, and the entire process—from registration to consultation—was smooth and efficient. It’s reassuring to have such a reliable hospital nearby. Thank you to the entire team for your excellent care and support.

featured_reviews.name: Abusama Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been regularly visiting Jain Hospital, Goregaon for my wife’s pregnancy check-ups under the care of Dr. Mamatha Shriyan, and I must say the experience has been excellent.

Dr. Mamatha Shriyan is highly experienced, professional, and very supportive throughout the journey. She listens patiently, explains every detail clearly, and always makes sure we feel comfortable and confident about the treatment and upcoming steps. Her guidance in diet, medicines, and regular follow-ups has been
extremely helpful.

The hospital staff is also polite and cooperative. The facilities at Jain Hospital are clean, well-maintained, and organized. Appointments are well managed, and waiting time is reasonable.

We truly appreciate the personal care and attention we are receiving during this important phase of our life. I highly recommend Dr. Mamatha Shriyan and Jain Hospital, Goregaon for pregnancy care and women’s health.
